title: Strategic Demonstration Selection for Improved Fairness in LLM In-Context Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating fairness metrics, specifically Demographic Parity (DP) and Equalized Odds (Eodds), between male and female subgroups using tabular datasets (Adult Income and Credit Default). The methodology also includes applying counterfactual perturbations to gender labels in the few-shot in-context learning demonstrations to measure how the ratio of minority to majority group samples impacts LLM prediction fairness.
